The '''Central Wasteland''' was one of the three major land masses on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. It was bordered by the the [[Northern Ocean]], [[Triad Sea]], and [[Southern Ocean (Kathol)|Southern Ocean]]. The continent was rocky with some isolated ruins on the southern coast. The Central Wasteland was dominated by the [[Segmi]] and [[Zizimaak]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
